conclusion: For the recorded latest local candidate and three input hashes, six awaited fresh Windows native slices all exited 0 and produced G-code, but warning-free verification failed. Benchy and Vulcan600 each emit five initialization, metadata and compatibility warnings. X2 additionally emits 47 missing-Voronoi-vertex retry warnings, six post-rotation errors and one MedialAxis error after morphological closing; counts repeat exactly. All ordered commands, motion annotations and emitted configuration agree between each pair of runs. Native exit 0 does not establish geometry validity. Windows CLI result.json emission is Linux-guarded, so audit native logging and source severity rather than relying on a nonexistent structured warning array. Exact affected layers and a geometry repair remain unverified.

The finding is verified, while zero-error/warning product acceptance failed. X2 geometry errors are reproduced and unrepaired; no exact layer is claimed.
